views.definition: SELECT (((((a.patient_id)::text || '@'::text) || (a.visit_id)::text) || '-'::text) || (d.diagnosis_no)::text) AS casepk, a.inp_no AS banum, a.visit_id AS zycs, NULL::text AS medicalinsurancenumber, b.name, b.sex, b.nation AS minzu, b.id_no AS idcard, b.date_of_birth AS birthday, a.age AS agesui, a.age_month AS ageyue, a.age_day AS ageday, a.marital_status AS hunyin, a.occupation AS zhiye, b.citizenship AS guoji, a.service_agency AS workinfo, a.home_tel AS iphone, NULL::text AS culturelevel, a.nomen AS hukouxxdz, a.mailing_address AS xxxzz, a.admission_date_time AS rytime, a.discharge_date_time AS cytime, a.dept_discharge_from AS cyksbm, (SELECT dept_dict.dept_name FROM jhemr.dept_dict WHERE ((a.dept_discharge_from)::text = (dept_dict.dept_code)::text)) AS cyksname, a.doctor_in_charge_id AS zzyscode, a.doctor_in_charge AS zzysname, d.diagnosis_code, d.diagnosis_desc AS icd10name, d.diagnosis_date AS treattime, NULL::text AS diseasetime, d.diagnosis_date AS confirmtime, (SELECT d.diagnosis_code FROM jhemr.diagnosis d WHERE ((((d.patient_id)::text = (a.patient_id)::text) AND (d.visit_id = a.visit_id)) AND ((d.diagnosis_type)::text = '8'::text)) ORDER BY d.diagnosis_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS xingtaixuenamsm, (SELECT d.diagnosis_desc FROM jhemr.diagnosis d WHERE ((((d.patient_id)::text = (a.patient_id)::text) AND (d.visit_id = a.visit_id)) AND ((d.diagnosis_type)::text = '8'::text)) ORDER BY d.diagnosis_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS xingtainame, a.discharge_disposition AS lyfs, NULL::text AS departmenttelephone, NULL::text AS blxlxms, (SELECT jhemr.blob_to_char(aa.dg_plain_content_blob) AS blob_to_char FROM (jhfile.jhmr_file_content_dg aa JOIN jhemr.jhmr_file_index bb ON ((((((aa.patient_id)::text = (bb.patient_id)::text) AND (aa.visit_id = bb.visit_id)) AND ((aa.patient_id)::text = (a.patient_id)::text)) AND (aa.visit_id = a.visit_id)))) WHERE (((bb.delete_flag = (0)::numeric) AND ((bb.file_flag)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('1'::varchar)::text, ('2'::varchar)::text, ('3'::varchar)::text]))) AND (((aa.dg_code)::text = 'S.01'::text) AND (ROWNUM = 1)))) AS chiefcomplaint, a.next_of_kin AS contacts, a.next_of_kin_phone AS contacphone FROM ((jhemr.pat_visit a LEFT JOIN jhemr.pat_master_index b ON (((a.patient_id)::text = (b.patient_id)::text))) LEFT JOIN jhemr.diagnosis d ON
